groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Strong Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.673% and the 10Y at 4.988%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -3.23% over five sessions and -4.68% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.71% at about $113.97, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is strong negative (-48/100, 77% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is limited positive confirmation on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
